demand_reserve_missing_overlap.comparison_clock: hourly interval end, Asia/Seoul local-naive timestamps

observed_cutoff_check.rule: all group 1/5/6/7/11 and SMP history statistics use observations whose interval end/time is <= forecast_origin - 72 hours; a single cutoff is shared across the 72 target hours

future_observation_perturbation_check.rule: all future observations after each sampled cutoff were replaced by a large sentinel; historical features remained unchanged

kma_issue_time_check.note: Latest exact-target-day archived issue no later than each forecast origin; selected issue timestamps are retained in forecast_inputs.csv. Exact-target forecasts may have been issued several days earlier; lead days are retained. No target-day observations are used to fill an absent forecast.

conditional_future_known_input: Group 8 domestic LNG fuel cost is intentionally matched by each target timestamp's month under the agreed same-month conditional historical experiment; it is not asserted to have been published by the forecast origin.

epsis_actual_demand.aggregation: 12 five-minute current-load snapshots per clock hour; mean only when all 12 exist; output is interval-end timestamp

kpx_generation.availability_rule: raw generation v2 values; only intervals ending at the common forecast_origin - 72h cutoff are used

kpx_renewables.aggregation: 2023-01..11: sum province rows excluding Jeju only if all 16 land regions have values; 2023-12..2025: solar sums province/city rows excluding Jeju and excludes aggregate land row, wind selects explicit land row; MWh; blanks retained

kpx_supply_reserve.aggregation: mean of all 12 five-minute samples in clock hour; result timestamp is interval end; incomplete hours remain NaN

kma_asos.night_definition: calculated solar elevation <= 0 degrees for Seoul ASOS 108; missing SI remains missing regardless of night

smp.availability_rule: SMP hour values are treated as available only after their hourly interval ends; source hour-start timestamp + 1h must be <= the common observed cutoff because per-hour publication timestamps are unavailable

day_ahead_demand_forecast.rule: past demand forecast history only at common cutoff; no target-day D+1/D+2/D+3 official forecast attached

old_group1_candidate.reason: not the requested EPSIS land actual-load series

limitations: EPSIS historical current-load page does not carry a row-level geography field; the main monitoring page is treated as the mainland system based on the separately exposed Jeju monitoring page, and this scope inference is recorded.
Actual publication timestamps for EPSIS/KPX/ASOS observations are not verified; the common 72-hour cutoff is a conservative research assumption, not a measured release-delay fact.
SMP hourly publication time is not present in the source; only completed hourly values through the common 72-hour cutoff are used.
Demand forecast issue timestamps are not verified; group 2 is used only as past forecast history and conservatively cut at 72 hours.

Group 6 excludes Jeju where region is explicit; 2023 provincial wind/sun values are summed only for complete rows and may remain missing; source coverage excludes PPA/BTM and may represent market trades only.
Domestic LNG same-target-month input is a conditional historical experiment, not a feature confirmed available at forecast origin.
Group 12 issue timestamps are used where archived; daily forecast periods and source categories are not expanded into hourly weather values.
